title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):

items: Launched on 28 August 2014 by the Ministry of Finance, aims to provide financial inclusion to
deprived sections of society.
Objectives:
o Financial Inclusion – One bank account per household.
o Basic Banking Services – Accessible to the underprivileged.
Key Features:
o Zero Balance Accounts – No minimum balance required.
o Accident Insurance – ₹2 lakh coverage.
o Overdraft Facility – ₹10,000 for eligible users.
o Rupay Debit Card – Provided to account holders.
o Direct Benefit Transfers – For government benefits.
o Mobile Banking – Accessible through mobile phones.
Achievements:
o 53 crore accounts opened (29 crore by women).
o ₹1.75 lakh crore in deposits.
Challenges:
o Account Dormancy – Many accounts remain inactive.
o Infrastructure Gaps – Limited banking access in some rural areas.
PMJDY empowers low-income families with access to financial services and government benefits.
